name: Thor-T-35B-A3B

lineage.how_derived: post-training ternary quantization (weights -1, 0, +1 in one to four planes per tensor) with a ternary multi-token-prediction head in every file, built with the open forge Fucina on a Ryzen AI Max+ 395 APU

purpose: Ternary GGUF files of Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B in three sizes that keep near-teacher quality at 2 bits per weight and add an MTP head for speed (card).

license.name: CC BY 4.0 (card); base licence file shipped as LICENSE.base-model
license.notes: Card tag cc-by-4.0; the licence text was not read and the base model's own licence is unconfirmed in our database (Ornith 1.5 card tag MIT, LICENSE missing).

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated-DeltaNet plus full attention MoE (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B layout) in ternary planes
architecture.drafter: ternary MTP head inside every file

variants.notes: M 12.19 GiB; S 8.82 GiB (2.135 bpw); XS 8.04 GiB (1.946 bpw); root 8.24 GiB; GB figure converted from GiB

pc-12gb.notes: 13.09 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-16gb.notes: 13.09 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~3 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-24gb.notes: 13.09 GB file fits the VRAM budget (21.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-32gb.notes: 13.09 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.notes: 13.09 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 13.09 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 13.09 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

other: fork Anjielon/llama.cpp tag thor-t-v1 (Vulkan, CUDA, CPU)
engine_support.notes: Does not load in upstream llama.cpp yet (card).

benchmarks.name: full MMLU (14,042 questions, zero-shot, log-probability)
benchmarks.variant: M ternary 12.19 GiB; Q8_0 teacher 80.59, Q4_K_M 80.16; same engine, author's measurement

benchmarks.name: decode speed with MTP
benchmarks.variant: M on AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 APU (Vulkan); XS 95.42; on an RTX 4060 Laptop 8 GB with experts partly in RAM M 39.2

strengths: MMLU level with Q4_K_M at 60 percent of the bytes (author's paired test)
XS file at 8 GB gives 66 tok/s on an 8 GB laptop GPU with RAM experts
weaknesses: one author, MMLU is the main quality measure
soft.maturity: 20.7k downloads, 6 likes; paper PDF in the repo (not read)

tona_fit.reason: A concrete test of ternary multi-plane quantization on a 35B-A3B MoE with an MTP head, relevant to our bandwidth-bound RAM path. Base is Ornith 1.5 and quality beyond MMLU is not shown; the technique, not the files, is what to study.
blockers: licence unclear for a derived work

open_questions: coding and agentic quality of the ternary files
paper details and reproducibility of the Fucina recipe

sources.note: README read; the config.json and LICENSE paths 404 (GGUF-only repo)
